title: 購物
description: 商店購物時常用的對話句型

sentences.en: How much does this cost?
I'm just looking, thanks.
Do you have this in a smaller size?
sentences.zh: 這個有小一點的尺寸嗎？

sentences.en: Can I try this on?
Where is the fitting room?
I'm looking for a birthday gift.
Do you accept credit cards?
Is this on sale?
Can I get a receipt, please?
I'd like to return this item.
Do you have this in another color?
This is too expensive for me.
I'll take this one.
Can you give me a discount?
Where can I find the electronics section?
Is there a warranty on this product?
I need a bag, please.
Do you have anything cheaper?
What time does the store close?
Can I exchange this for a different size?
sentences.zh: 我可以換不同的尺寸嗎？

sentences.en: I'm looking for something for my wife.
How long is the return policy?
This doesn't fit me well.
I'll pay in cash.
Could you wrap this as a gift?
sentences.zh: 可以幫我包裝成禮物嗎？

sentences.en: Are there any promotions right now?
sentences.zh: 現在有什麼促銷活動嗎？

sentences.en: I'd like to compare these two products.
Is this the latest model?
I'll come back later to decide.
Can I have this delivered to my home?
